name: Is epoxy grout better than standard cement grout with sealer?

mainEntity.name: Is epoxy grout better than standard cement grout with sealer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Epoxy grout is exceptionally durable, non-porous, and resistant to stains and harsh chemicals, meaning it never requires a topical or penetrating sealer. However, standard cementitious grout costs less upfront and is much easier to work with, especially on large floor plans. The tradeoff with epoxy is that it sets quickly and requires meticulous cleaning during installation to prevent hazy residue on tile faces. For heavy-use walk-in showers or commercial kitchen floors, epoxy is often worth the extra installation effort to eliminate recurring resealing chores.
acceptedAnswer.description: Epoxy grout is virtually stain-proof and never needs sealing, making it great for wet zones, though standard cement grout is less costly and easier to install.
